prose: Leaker Aaron Perris found evidence of an Apple Mac app called Harbor, which would turn a Mac into a private AI inference server for open-weight models on Apple silicon, with data staying on-device. Multiple Macs could be linked over Thunderbolt 5 to pool unified memory for larger models and more concurrency. Unannounced; reported from leaked evidence.
highlights: Harbor: a local inference server app for Mac
Thunderbolt 5 pooling of unified memory across Macs
